item.text:
Refactored the codebase to be more extensible by improving both the graph API and the analysis contract.

The main changes are in [GraphAnalysis.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/031_articulation_points/GraphAnalysis.java), [Graph.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/031_articulation_points/Graph.java), [GraphBuilder.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/031_articulation_points/GraphBuilder.java), [GraphValidation.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/031_articulation_points/GraphValidation.java), and [ArticulationPointAnalysis.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/031_articulation_points/ArticulationPointAnalysis.java). `GraphAnalysis` now has a shared `validate -> compute` flow, so future analyses can declare preconditions without duplicating wrapper logic. `Graph` now exposes immutable edge data, `edgeCount()`, and `copyBuilder()`, and `GraphBuilder` can ingest `Iterable<Edge>` or another `Graph`, which makes graph transforms and derived graphs easier to implement without reaching into adjacency internals.

Verification passed with `javac *.java && java ArticulationPoints`, and the output remains `1 4`.
